title: Automated Web Form Filling and Submission at Scale
summary: Reads company data from sheets, finds each form's fields, fills them intelligently and submits them using a headless browser.
headline: Web forms that fill themselves
problem: Submitting the same details to many different web forms by hand was slow.
solution: n8n loads the rows from Google Sheets, scrapes each form's fields, and an AI agent maps the data to the fields. The result is submitted with Browserless. I built variants for generic web forms and for Typeform.
role: Sole engineer. I built both automations.
